name: wiki0
description: Local-first AI memory as a Markdown wiki backed by SQLite search and MCP tools
author: Scott Spence <me@scottspence.com>

scripts.build: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && pnpm --filter wiki0-web run build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && vp check && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run check:self && pnpm --filter wiki0-web run check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && vp test && pnpm --filter wiki0-web run test
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:package
